items.q: His name was Jeff Cass, and he had come out of Louisville, out of that band. We had played together, and he was on trumpet and I'm on a trumpet

ctx.x: Yeah, he was bigger before, and I think he probably cut it down, and then he wanted to -- because when I got there, another one of the fellows out of the band was playing the trumpet. His name was Jeff Cass, and he had come out of Louisville, out of that band. We had played together, and he was on trumpet and I'm on a trumpet, and Milt Robinson's on trombone, so the whole brass section's out of there, you know.
